tasks.title: Implement high-precision calculation accuracy
tasks.description:
Review and fix calculation logic in Calculator.tsx to ensure 99.99% accuracy:

1. Read src/components/Calculator.tsx and analyze the current calculation logic
2. Verify IEEE 754 double-precision floating-point arithmetic is correctly implemented
3. Fix any precision issues in arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /, =)
4. Handle edge cases for range ±9,999,999,999
5. Implement proper rounding to avoid cumulative errors

Then write comprehensive tests in Calculator.test.tsx:
6. Add test suite with 10,000 random calculations across all operations
7. Validate results match expected precision to 14 significant digits
8. Verify rounding errors do not exceed ±0.0001 for any operation
9. Test cumulative error across chained operations
10. Cover all operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division

Reference existing test patterns in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx and extend them.
acceptance_criteria: Calculator uses IEEE 754 double-precision arithmetic correctly
Test suite includes 10,000 random calculation validations
All edge cases for ±9,999,999,999 range handled

tasks.title: Validate calculation accuracy requirements
tasks.description:
Run the comprehensive test suite to validate calculation accuracy:

1. Execute: npm test -- Calculator.test.tsx
2. Verify all 10,000 random calculation tests pass
3. Confirm precision requirements are met (14 significant digits)
4. Validate rounding error bounds (≤ ±0.0001)
5. Check cumulative error tolerance
6. Ensure 99.99% accuracy target is achieved
